parallel.requirements: Recognized the required Python-to-Node migration: ESM .mjs files, manual CLI parsing, no external packages or prohibited built-ins, IDNA encode/decode behavior, first-label alabel/ulabel output, and /output delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent delegated probing and reference-search work while still owning final reconciliation and verification. Multiple children wrote into the same /output workspace and produced overlapping module layouts.
parallel.implementation: Children and parent built custom CLI parsing, byte formatting, punycode/bootstring, validation, IDNA core helpers, and test1.mjs. Search and Probe produced competing layouts before the parent settled on argparse_like.mjs and lib/idna modules.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integration was unstable because child Search deleted files from the shared output tree that the parent entrypoint still imported. The parent inspected the failure, rewired imports, restored coherent modules, and delivered a passing tree.
parallel.verification: Parent ran side-by-side checks against the executable, saw an ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND failure after child cleanup, then reran a final scripted comparison that returned matched before the official 125/125 pass.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No final official defect remained. The observed defect was a transient broken entrypoint/import graph during final verification caused by concurrent workspace writes.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, manual parser, local module, no external dependency, and IDNA output-alignment requirements from the identical prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor owned discovery, implementation, integration, testing, and final delivery with no child work or shared-workspace handoff.
serial.implementation: Built a flat library tree with bytes, CLI, errors, punycode, validation, idna, index, and test1.mjs modules, then patched uppercase A-label decoding and code-point formatting.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Maintained a coherent /output tree throughout finalization and closed with a file list that matched the delivered artifact.
serial.verification: Ran sample and edge-case checks against the executable, including uppercase A-labels, Unicode separator behavior, parser errors, and final byte-for-byte stdout comparisons.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No final official defect remained and no serial-control violation or delegation was observed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the ESM .mjs, manual CLI, no external dependency, no Python embedding, and IDNA behavior requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the identical prompt and recognized the same implementation and output-alignment requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements difference remained; both targeted the same obligations and passed them.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used executed child agents and the parent retained final integration ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents and one actor owned the whole implementation through verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created overlapping implementation ownership in a shared workspace; serial avoided that coordination surface.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Children produced alternate module/interface choices while writing to the same output tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial evolved one local interface set and patched it directly when it found drift.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had competing module names and import paths to reconcile, while serial changed one known interface surface.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel combined parent fixes with child-generated CLI and IDNA modules after an import-path break.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the implementation, found an uppercase A-label bug, and patched the same module tree directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's implementation path included recovery from competing deliverable edits; serial's path was a linear debug-and-patch loop.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent interrupted Search after it had already performed the cleanup that broke the active import graph.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results, joins, or interrupts; it directly observed its own test failures and patches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had lifecycle coordination around live child work; serial had a single local lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Search deleted active output files including /output/lib/cli/argparse.mjs while the parent entrypoint still imported that deliverable path.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept a coherent flat module tree and reported a stable final file map.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material divergence is the parallel shared-state collision; serial had no competing writer to invalidate the entrypoint tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final verification first exposed a missing module and later passed after parent reconciliation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final byte-for-byte checks matched the executable before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification served as a recovery point for a concurrency-induced break; serial verification confirmed an already coherent tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used far more requests, tool calls, and subagent work but did not time out and closed after repair.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one rollout, fewer requests and tools, and closed after final verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel carried higher coordination and recovery cost, but both had enough budget for final passing closure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Current completed official status for both modes reports 125 of 125 passing samples, so the correct relation is both_pass. The parallel run nevertheless has an observed adverse coordination episode: a child cleanup deleted the CLI module path used by the parent entrypoint, producing an import failure during final verification. The parent repaired the tree and reran checks, so the episode did not create an official outcome difference. Serial solved the same task in one coherent implementation path and reached the same official result without that shared-write recovery step.
parallel_contributors: Parallel used child agents that wrote overlapping /output module trees.
Search child cleanup deleted an active CLI module used by test1.mjs.
Parent detected the missing-module failure and repaired before official evaluation.
serial_contributors: Serial used one actor with no child-agent shared workspace.
Serial found and patched uppercase A-label behavior directly before final checks.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two final passing solutions used different module layouts and different helper names.
Both encountered IDNA edge-case drift during development and fixed it before closure.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference after parent recovery
